ERR_DATA_MATRIX_FULL.message: The data matrix has no room for another role, route or callback

ERR_DATA_MATRIX_PAIR.message: A route from end kind {from} to end kind {to} is not possible
ERR_DATA_MATRIX_PAIR.hint: Raw bytes need a provider with the Raw role, tagged data one with the Session role (or Raw as a target); a stream cannot feed a stream.

ERR_DATA_MATRIX_TOO_LONG.message: {len} bytes are too long to send (at most {max})

ERR_DATA_MATRIX_QUEUE_FULL.message: Stream {stream} is sending faster than its connections carry: {len} bytes dropped
